name: Bonito
tagline: Snorkel in crystal-clear rivers full of fish
summary: Bonito is Brazil's eco-tourism model town, where limestone filters the rivers to astonishing clarity. Float down the Rio da Prata among huge dourado fish, see the blue lake inside the Gruta do Lago Azul cave, watch macaws circle in the giant Buraco das Araras sinkhole and swim under waterfalls.
seasonNote: Water is clearest in the drier months; every tour has a daily cap, so book ahead.
arrival: Flights to Bonito or Campo Grande (then 4 hours by road).
gettingAround: Tours include transport; a car helps.
cashTip: Cards and Pix work almost everywhere. Tours are booked through agencies in town.
foodTip: Pacu and pintado river fish, and churrasco.
